title: 2D L3 photonic crystal cavity in air, quarter model with two mirror planes (FDFD eigenfrequency)
description:
An L3 cavity (three missing holes in a row) in a finite triangular lattice of air holes (a = 420 nm, r = 0.29 a) cut into a dielectric patch of eps_eff 8.12 (n 2.85, the TE effective index of a 220 nm silicon slab at 1550 nm, as nanobeam_cavity_fdfd), with air all around the patch and CPML beyond the air. The two holes closing the cavity are shifted outward by s_end (0.15 a, Akahane's L3; 0 = the plain L3). Solved by the eigenfrequency study in em_fdfd_hz (E in the plane, the TE-like slab modes) on the cpu backend with host SuperLU. In 2D the mode leaks only in the plane, through the hole rows into the air and the PML, so Q grows roughly exponentially with the crystal size; the patch edges can also hold edge (surface) modes, which the probes below tell apart from the cavity.
Quarter model: the cavity centre is the origin, the domain holds x, y >= 0, x_lo is a symmetric mirror plane (E mirror-even: E_y even and H_z odd about x = 0) and y_lo an antisymmetric one (E mirror-odd: E_x odd, E_y even and H_z even about the cavity axis y = 0). That is the parity of the fundamental L3 mode (dominant E_y, even about both planes); the holes on x = 0 and y = 0 are drawn about the edges and halved by them. For the other parities flip bc_x_lo / bc_y_lo (the second-order L3 mode has E_y odd along the axis: bc_x_lo antisymmetric).
Crystal size: n_rows hole rows above the cavity row (the unfolded crystal has 2 n_rows + 1 rows) and n_side holes on each side of the cavity in the cavity row (default n_rows + 1, so one parameter grows the crystal both ways; set a number to decouple). The rows alternate between two arrays (holes_a on y = 0, 2 h, ..., holes_b offset by a / 2 on y = h, 3 h, ...; h = sqrt(3) a / 2); ny_a / ny_b split n_rows by parity without floor ((-1)^n = cos(pi n)). The patch ends a / 2 beyond the outermost hole centres. The cavity holes are filled back with the patch material (defect_fill, after the hole arrays: later materials win) and the end hole is drawn again at (2 + s_end) a.
Target: f_target = a / lambda = 0.265 is an estimate (the 3D L3 sits near 0.26-0.27), not from a run: the study returns the 6 resonances nearest it. If the cavity row is not row 0, set f_target to its a_over_lambda (the PML stretch and materials are frozen at the target) and run again.
Probes (field derived values read resonance 1, the one nearest the target, with H_z scaled to 1 at its peak): cavity_1 = its region_energy_fraction in cavity_region (the three missing holes plus a, out to the first-row hole centres: the cavity mode keeps a large share, an edge or band-edge mode almost none; set the resonance_table's min_region_fraction to e.g. 0.3 to drop those from the solve); centre_ratio = |E| at the cavity centre / its maximum over the solid core of the cavity (the fundamental mode has its E_y antinode at the centre, close to 1); side_ratio = Re E_y at x = a (the next missing hole) / Re E_y at the centre (sign and size are a fingerprint of the mode: note them for a run you trust, a jump in them flags another mode); V_norm = mode area of eps |E|^2 over the unfolded crystal / (lambda / n)^2. Q_max (largest Q of the 6 rows) flags a high-Q cavity mode that is not row 0.
Sweep tab: lambda_1, Q_1 (log axis), cavity_1, centre_ratio and side_ratio vs n_rows = 3-8 (n_side follows): Q should grow steadily while the probes stay put; a step in a probe means the solve picked another mode.
Mesh: uniform, 30 cells per a (14 nm, ~38 per wavelength in the patch), ~1e5 unknowns at n_rows 6. GPU: set solver_defaults backend 'gpu' and the eigen_solver factorization 'GPU cuDSS' (needs nvmath-python). No closed-form reference: a demonstration, not a self-test.
Field tab: |H_z|, Re H_z and |E| of each resonance (Snapshot slider; the GUI shows the unfolded crystal).

parameters.name: h_row
parameters.description: row spacing of the triangular lattice

parameters.name: eps_slab
parameters.description: patch permittivity (TE effective index 2.85 of a 220 nm silicon slab)

parameters.name: s_end
parameters.description: outward shift of the two holes closing the cavity, in units of a (0 = plain L3)

parameters.name: n_rows
parameters.description: hole rows above (and below) the cavity row (swept)

parameters.name: n_side
parameters.description: holes on each side of the cavity in the cavity row

parameters.name: ny_b
parameters.description: rows of holes_b (y = h, 3 h, ...): ceil(n_rows / 2)

parameters.name: x_patch
parameters.description: patch half-length: a / 2 beyond the outermost hole centre

parameters.name: y_patch
parameters.description: patch half-height: a / 2 beyond the outermost row

parameters.name: margin
parameters.description: air between the patch and the CPML

parameters.name: f_target
parameters.description: target a / lambda (estimate; set it to the cavity's a_over_lambda after a first run)
